baseline.description: new name/layout only; behaviour is still the vanilla row (stub)

r0_single.description: R0 control: single exaggerated diagnostic state; duration = 10s + 5s x TOTAL Afterglow level

strings.long:
R0 DIAGNOSTIC (Fire stance)
BENEFIT: +500% Defense (see Character sheet)
PENALTY: -50% run speed, -100 Fire Resist
Duration: 10s + 5s per total Afterglow level

r1_leapchain.description: R1 leap-chain: srvstfunc 23 applies BENEFIT (aurastate); srvdofunc 170 casts hidden helper (calc5) that applies PENALTY

strings.long:
R1 DIAGNOSTIC (Fire stance)
BENEFIT state: +500% Defense, flame wreath
PENALTY state (hidden helper): -50% run speed, -100 Fire Resist, green swirl

r2a_func18.description: R2a: no chain; srvdofunc 18 applies ONE state with benefit+penalty stats (checks the stat pipeline with the armor function)

strings.long:
R2a DIAGNOSTIC (Fire)
One state: +500% Defense, -50% run speed, -100 Fire Resist
(expect all three on the Character sheet / run speed)

r3_chain_missile.description: R3: do=170; calc5 chains the PENALTY helper (func 18); srvmissilea spawns an invisible self-hit pulse that applies the BENEFIT helper

strings.long:
R3 DIAGNOSTIC (Fire)
BENEFIT: +500% Defense (holy-fire rings)
PENALTY: -50% run speed x2, -100 Fire Resist (green swirl)

r4_swapped.description: R4a: roles swapped vs R3: chain (calc5) applies BENEFIT, srvmissilea pulse applies PENALTY

strings.long:
R4a DIAGNOSTIC (Fire)
BENEFIT via chain: +500% Defense (holy-fire rings)
PENALTY via self-hit pulse: -50% run speed, -100 Fire Resist (green swirl)
If only the benefit appears, the pulse-missile route does not work.

r5_targetstate.description: R5: chain (calc5) = PENALTY (aurastate), srvmissilea pulse = BENEFIT via helper auratargetstate (range 15, player filter)

strings.long:
R3 DIAGNOSTIC (Fire)
BENEFIT: +500% Defense (holy-fire rings)
PENALTY: -50% run speed x2, -100 Fire Resist (green swirl)

r6_func18_missile.description: R6a: stance row do=18 applies BENEFIT itself; srvmissilea spawns a VISIBLE shockwave pulse whose helper applies the PENALTY via target-state

strings.long:
R6a DIAGNOSTIC (Fire)
BENEFIT from the row: +500% Defense, holy-fire rings
A visible shockwave should appear at her feet; if it does, the PENALTY (slow, -100 Fire Resist, green swirl) is applied by it.
No shockwave = the missile never spawns from a func-18 row.

R7 DIAGNOSTIC (Fire) - single mutually exclusive state, 60s + 10s per stance level
BOON: +500% Defense (holy-fire rings)
BUST: -50% run speed (x2 stats), -100 Fire Resist
ECHO: +10 Strength per total Echo level (a share of Cold's boon)

R8 (Fire stance) 60s + 10s/lvl, 20s cooldown, slow cast
BOON: +50% fire skill damage, +75% faster cast rate
BUST: -30% physical damage resist (amplified damage)
ECHO: +1% cold and lightning skill damage per Echo level
Overlay: burning ground
